7.5.3 Activities in the Poll Sequence
The Poll Sequence in sleep modes can be used to check the wakeup sources.
[SWS_EcuM_03020]
Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_00002
⌈In the Poll sequence the EcuM shall call the callouts EcuM_SleepActivity and
EcuM_CheckWakeupHook() in a blocking loop (if EcuMWakeupSourcePolling is
set to true) until a pending/validated wakeup event is reported.⌋
